tools.name: run_waitlist_backfill_job
tools.description: Runs the clinic's waitlist backfill script, which offers newly opened appointment slots on a given date to waitlisted patients. The outcome of the run, including how many slots were filled, is saved to the clinic's job history.

params.name: clinic_id
params.description: Identifier of the clinic location, e.g. 'CLN-042'.

params.name: service_date
params.description: Date whose open slots should be backfilled, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: max_offers
params.description: Maximum number of slot offers to send out in this run (1-200).

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, the script calculates matches without booking anything.

tools.name: charge_no_show_fee
tools.description: Charges a patient's card on file the clinic's no-show fee for a missed appointment and records the fee against that appointment.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the patient, e.g. 'cus_...'.

tools.name: revoke_caregiver_proxy_access
tools.description: Removes a caregiver's proxy access to a patient's portal account so they can no longer view or book appointments for that patient. Any appointment requests the caregiver submitted for the patient that are still pending are permanently deleted.

params.name: patient_id
params.description: ID of the patient whose portal account the caregiver can access.

params.name: caregiver_user_id
params.description: Portal user ID of the caregiver whose proxy access should be removed.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for revoking access, kept with the access record.

tools.name: archive_completed_appointment
tools.description: Moves a completed appointment out of the active schedule and into the appointment archive.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the completed appointment to archive.
